_what: Curve cohorts whose vendor was re-queried and whose stored curves were confirmed to still reproduce. catalogue_audit.py reads this so a cohort that HAS been checked stops asking to be checked. A cohort absent from this file is unverified, which is the loud case.
_how_to_add: Only after an actual re-pull compared against stored values, with a comparator shown to report drift as well as agreement. Record what was measured, not what was believed. Always record rowsAtVerification: a cohort that grows after it was checked is STALE, not verified, and the new rows have been looked at by nobody.

curve_date_skew.method: random sample, seeded, drawn with no defect signature
curve_date_skew.outcome: drift traced to ONE re-evaluated vendor model record shared by 11 rows (220 pF / C0402 / X7R / commercial order codes), all 11 repaired; 1,009 of a 1,020-part boundary sweep were bit-for-bit identical
